boundary: This register audits design controls and unresolved gates. It does not establish construct validity, causal identification, privacy, meaningful consent, rights clearance, accessibility, hearing safety, clinical safety, or benefit.

status_definitions.mixed: Some named behavior is implemented only in the synthetic prototype; material target controls remain unimplemented or unqualified.
status_definitions.specified: The manuscript or frozen protocol states a requirement, but no qualifying execution demonstrates that it works.
status_definitions.unresolved: No adequate control or evidence is currently registered.
status_definitions.blocked: The named activity cannot proceed until the gate is independently satisfied and recorded.

risks.title: Construct and inference
risks.current_control: Keep intended, realized, perceived, felt, usefulness-or-harm, and later fields separate; retain correction and missingness.
risks.residual_risk: Measures remain unvalidated for this use, and optional passive signals can be ambiguous.
risks.blocking_gate: Instrument and construct-validity review before H1

risks.title: Internal and statistical validity
risks.current_control: Freeze assignment, denominators, missingness, null and adverse retention, and the exact randomization analysis.
risks.residual_risk: An unblinded self-study, bundled conditions, expectancy, order, carryover, and a short series prevent causal or population inference.
risks.blocking_gate: H1 analysis review; new protocol for efficacy claims

risks.title: External and ecological validity
risks.current_control: Bound every claim to the tested person, moment, revision, model, device, and listening setting.
risks.residual_risk: Transfer across people, cultures, languages, generators, devices, sensory needs, and care settings is unknown.

risks.title: Model, timing, and continuity
risks.current_control: Synthetic consent, hashes, cancellation, stop, and recovery are tested; real-model buffering and rendering checks are specified.
risks.residual_risk: State estimates, adapters, analyzers, deadlines, transitions, and fallbacks are not qualified end to end.
risks.blocking_gate: Real-model and complete-session gates before H1

risks.title: Emotional and hearing safety
risks.current_control: Preserve playback and stop authority; record mismatch, harm, discomfort, and aftereffect separately; begin at low device level.
risks.residual_risk: No control is shown to prevent overwhelm; at-ear level, cumulative dose, and crisis response remain unknown.
risks.blocking_gate: Safety plan, device/dose qualification, and independent review

risks.title: Consent, privacy, and export
risks.current_control: Scoped grants and reviewed projection execute for synthetic manual context; research export remains fail-closed by contract.
risks.residual_risk: Meaningful consent, encryption, keys, backup, retention, deletion, redaction, re-identification, and export are not privacy-qualified.
risks.blocking_gate: Protected data-management and privacy review before H1

risks.title: Rights, bias, access, and review
risks.current_control: Real-model selection, generated-audio release, and formal collection remain blocked pending documented review.
risks.residual_risk: Licenses, training provenance, output rights, cultural bias, accessibility, misuse, and the applicable ethics determination are unresolved.
risks.blocking_gate: Model, data, audio, accessibility, misuse, and ethics review
